rules.rationale: Base equation defining the stringsOnly predicate on the empty ValSeq.
Recursive equation defining stringsOnly on a cons by testing the head and recursing on the tail.
Base equation defining scanEven to return its accumulator when the remaining input is empty.
Guarded recursive defining equation for scanEven that appends an even-length string head and consumes the tail; simplification is used as evaluator metadata for this definition.
Guarded recursive defining equation for scanEven that skips an odd-length string head and consumes the tail; simplification is used as evaluator metadata for this definition.
Totalizing recursive equation defining scanEven on a non-string head by skipping that head and consuming the tail.

Additional trusted definedness fact asserting that seqLen(V) is defined whenever isStrV(V) holds; Stage 1 compiles this simplification before all proofs and contains no prior proof of its exact statement in a module without the rule.
Macro expansion defining the named sortedListSumBody proof term as the exact translated function body.
Macro expansion defining sortedListSumModule from the named function body and entry-point signature.
